sprint_goal: Maya signs only a report that still checks VALID, and config show reads every shipped default.

seats.done_means: Serves O3 for Maya Okafor: the page she is asked to sign still checks VALID at the signature because a late ruling no longer moves it and sign will not seal one that has moved; and serves O2: config show tells her the true default of every key the skill ships rather than calling a shipped key undeclared.
seats.note: Two independent fixes joined by 'and', sharing no file, so not one increment; each is small and real, so carry both. BG0940's third clause (check's output naming an uncommitted fresh signature as awaiting its commit) has no criterion: either the build leaves it out or it ships unverified, and the review should hold it to that. BG0943's Summary says config.get also drops the keys; execution shows it does not, so the user-visible defect is show alone and the goal wording is right.

seats.done_means: Serves O3: decisions.py stops counting a ruling against a run whose page is filed and not reopened (the BG0926 late-total pattern), sign re-derives through sprint_report's existing compare and refuses naming the moved figure, and config show reads past a nested list, each with a test red on the current code.
seats.note: Sign refusing a page that already fails its own check is the existing check made to run at the point of signing (LC-008), not a new constraint; it must call sprint_report's existing re-derive and moved-figure path, not a second implementation, or the two will drift. Risk: a ruling must still be logged to decisions.md and counted after a reopen (AC1's positive control), never silently dropped. Risk: the uncommitted fresh signature already reads INVALID until committed; sign's re-derive must judge the page before the seal is written, or it refuses its own signature. BG0943 is confined to show's reader; config.get is already right, so no review behaviour moves, and the fix should make show use the same parse rather than patch a second parser.

seats.done_means: Serves O3: each Verify is seen red on its Fails-on and green after, with a positive control beside each refusal, so the oracle, not an assertion, shows sign refuses a moved page and still seals an unmoved one, and show prints every declared default.
seats.note: Partial because the goal says 'every shipped default' while BG0943 AC1 names three keys: the test should walk every leaf key in config-defaults.yaml through show, plus the undeclared-key negative, or the goal claims more than its evidence. BG0940 AC2 must assert the moved figure's name (operator_rulings) in the refusal and pair it with a sign that still seals an unchanged page, else a sign that refuses everything passes. AC1 needs the after-reopen ruling counted, already in its wording; hold the test to it. [LC-016] applies: sign judges the live re-derive, never the close's freeze.
